license_required.quote: Midwifery licensure in Louisiana is by examination only.

degree_required.value: Completion of all educational and clinical requirements approved by the board
degree_required.quote: Evidence of completion of all the educational and clinical requirements approved by the board.

degree_level.quote: The senior apprentice shall provide the board with evidence of completion of high school or its equivalent as approved by the board.

school_approval_basis.quote: "Approved program" means a midwifery school or a midwifery training program which is approved by the board for the education of midwives.

credential_pegged.quote: the board may issue a midwifery license to an applicant who holds current certification by the North American Registry of Midwives or such other certifying organization as the board may subsequently approve.

required.quote: Clinical experience in licensed midwifery may be obtained in any setting - office, clinic, hospital, maternity center, or home. The board shall provide by regulation for the required types and numbers of experiences.

experience_source.quote: Clinical experience in licensed midwifery may be obtained in any setting - office, clinic, hospital, maternity center, or home. The board shall provide by regulation for the required types and numbers of experiences.

kind.value: clinical experience under supervision of a physician, certified nurse midwife, or licensed midwife
kind.quote: Apprentice midwives must obtain their clinical experience under the supervision of a physician, certified nurse midwife, or licensed midwife.

exams.name: Qualifying examination (written and practical)
exams.notes: Board offers examination at least twice a year; two-part exam with written and practical components. NARM examination is also accepted as qualifying.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered under the auspices of the board)
exams.quote: Any person applying for a midwifery license must pass a qualifying examination administered under the auspices of the board.

exams.name: North American Registry of Midwives (NARM) examination
exams.notes: Accepted as an alternative qualifying examination for midwifery licensure.
exams.quote: The examination administered by the North American Registry of Midwives, or such other certifying examination as the board may subsequently approve, shall be accepted by the board as a qualifying examination for purposes of midwifery licensure.

interval_years.quote: Every midwifery permit or license must be renewed every two years.

required.quote: Continuing education is required for renewal of license or permit under this Chapter.

hours_per_period.quote: In each two-year licensing period, thirty contact hours of continuing education must be obtained.

period_years.quote: In each two-year licensing period, thirty contact hours of continuing education must be obtained.

value: Board-designated specific topics based on identified problem areas
topical_requirements.quote: In any calendar year, the board may require specific topics for continuing education based upon any problem areas identified by the board.

available.quote: There is no reciprocity with other jurisdictions for purposes of the examination. Reciprocity may be applicable to clinical experience as provided in R.S. 37:3246.

requirements.value: No reciprocity for examination; applicants lacking required Louisiana clinical experience but having equivalent experience in another state may apply for a license and take the qualifying examination after submitting evidence of experience and all other requirements.
requirements.quote: Applicants for licensing as a licensed midwife who lack the required clinical experience in Louisiana, but who have equivalent experience in another state, may apply for a midwifery license and to take the qualifying examination after submitting evidence of experience and all other requirements.

credential_type.quote: "Licensed midwife" means a person who has completed all requirements of R.S. 37:3247, 3253, and 3255, has successfully completed the examination process, and is certified as a midwife by the North American Registry of Midwives along with being in good standing on the registry of licensed midwives maintained by the board.

is_mandatory.quote: Midwifery licensure in Louisiana is by examination only.

scope_protection.quote: Licensed midwifery in Louisiana is limited in scope to practice and outlined in this Section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly employing, supervising, or permitting an unlicensed person to perform work covered by these regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly employing, supervising, or permitting directly or indirectly or permitting any person or persons not an apprentice or licensed midwife to perform any work covered by these regulations.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using misleading or untruthful advertising or promotional material.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using or causing or promoting the use of any advertising matter, promotional literature, testimonial, or any other representation however disseminated or published, which is misleading or untruthful.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely representing that physician services will be used, or improperly using the word 'doctor' to connote the medical profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing that the service or advice of a person licensed to practice medicine will be used or made available when that is not true, or using the word "doctor", or similar words, abbreviations, or symbols so as to connote the medical profession when such is not the case.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting another person to use one's permit or license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting another to use his permit or license.

definition_quote.value: "Licensed midwifery" means the provision of health services in pregnancy and childbirth by a person not a licensed physician or a certified nurse midwife.
definition_quote.quote: "Licensed midwifery" means the provision of health services in pregnancy and childbirth by a person not a licensed physician or a certified nurse midwife.

methods_authorized.quote: Such care includes prenatal supervision and counseling; preparation for childbirth; and supervision and care during labor and delivery and care of the mother and the newborn in the immediate postpartum period if progress meets criteria generally accepted as normal as defined by the board.

national_credential_required.quote: "Licensed midwife" means a person who has completed all requirements of R.S. 37:3247, 3253, and 3255, has successfully completed the examination process, and is certified as a midwife by the North American Registry of Midwives along with being in good standing on the registry of licensed midwives maintained by the board.

cpr_certification_required.quote: Evidence of current certification in cardiopulmonary resuscitation of the adult and newborn.

clinical_birth_experience_requirements.value: Board shall provide by regulation for the required types and numbers of clinical experiences; clinical experience may be obtained in any setting.

independent_practice_permitted.quote: A licensed midwife may provide any care or services provided for in Subsection B of this Section.

apprentice_or_student_permit.quote: "Apprentice permit" means a permit issued by the Louisiana Department of Health to authorize a person desiring to become a licensed midwife to obtain clinical experience under supervision of a physician, certified nurse midwife, certified nurse practitioner specially qualified by the Louisiana State Board of Nursing, or licensed midwife.
